description: DAW-style transport: play and stop, arm recording and punch it in and out on the clock, with gates and triggers for a recorder and for a clock generator

params.text: Sets the recording length in counted clock cycles, 0 to 128; the upper display shows the figure, in red while the length is switched on
Switches the LENGTH counter on and off; the lamp is lit while the length is in use, and with it off recording runs for as long as it stays armed
Starts playback when pressed and stops it when pressed again, arming permitting; the lamp is lit for as long as the module is playing
Arms recording when pressed and disarms it when pressed again; the lamp blinks while an arming change is queued for the next quantised beat
Stops playback, disarms recording, clears both counters and fires a pulse from RST

inputs.text: A rising edge through 1V starts playback and the next one stops it; if recording is armed, recording starts with it
A rising edge through 1V arms recording and the next one disarms it; while the module is playing the change is queued for the next beat the Quantize Arming setting allows
A rising edge through 1V advances the counter, and only while playing; the counter steps once per several edges, according to the Incoming Clock Divider setting, which starts at 4
A rising edge through 1V stops playback, disarms recording, clears both counters and fires a pulse from RST

outputs.text: 10V for the whole time the module is playing and 0V while it is stopped
A 1ms pulse at 10V when playback starts, and another when it stops
A 1ms pulse at 10V on every reset, including the ones the On Start and On Stop settings send
10V for the whole time the module is playing with recording armed, and 0V at any other time
A 1ms pulse at 10V when recording starts, and another when it stops
A 1ms pulse at 10V at the start of each pass through the record length, whether recording or not; a sampler clocked from this stays in step with the clock the recording was made against

notes: the counters, the record length and the LOOP output all depend on a clock patched into CLK. With that jack empty the module will play and record, but it counts nothing and never punches out.
the upper display shows the record length and the lower one shows the elapsed count: bars played while the module is running, or bars recorded, in red, while it is armed.
every jack on the module is monophonic; only the first channel of a polyphonic cable is read.
menu: On Start: No action, Send Reset — chooses whether a reset pulse is fired when playback starts; it starts at No action
On Stop: No action, Send Reset — chooses whether a reset pulse is fired when playback stops; it starts at Send Reset
Incoming Clock Divider: 1, 2, 4 (MIDI-CV CLK/N), 8, 12, 16, 24 PPQN (MIDI-CV CLK), 48 PPQN — sets how many edges at CLK make one counted cycle; it starts at 4, for four beats in a bar
Quantize Arming: OFF, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128 — sets how many counted cycles pass before a queued arming change takes effect while playing; OFF applies it at once
Stop after record length? — when ticked, playback stops once the record length has been counted out, rather than the length governing the recording alone
Play button is toggle? — when ticked, a second play trigger stops playback; unticked, repeated play triggers leave the module playing
